goal: Bootstrap the codebase foundation and validation layer so all later agents share consistent structure, env validation, and Zod schemas.

tasks.title: Initialize Next.js App Router + TS strict project
steps: Create Next.js 14+ project using App Router
Enable TypeScript strict mode
Set up path aliases in tsconfig.json
Create folder scaffold: /app, /components, /components/ui, /lib, /db, /schemas, /sockets, /hooks, /middleware
outputs: tsconfig.json with strict: true and path aliases
verification: TypeScript compilation succeeds with strict mode

tasks.title: Configure Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
steps: Install and configure Tailwind CSS (tailwind.config.ts + globals.css)
Initialize shadcn/ui (components.json)
Add base shadcn/ui Button component to verify setup
verification: A simple page renders a shadcn/ui Button without errors

tasks.title: Configure linting + formatting
steps: Configure ESLint for Next.js + TypeScript
Configure Prettier and ensure it does not conflict with ESLint
Add scripts for lint/format if needed
verification: Formatting works consistently across TS/TSX files

tasks.title: Add EnvSchema validation bootstrap
steps: Create /schemas/env.schema.ts with EnvSchema
Create /lib/env.ts that parses process.env using EnvSchema.safeParse
Fail fast (throw) on invalid env with descriptive Zod errors
Create .env.local template and ensure .env.local is in .gitignore
verification: App crashes on startup if env vars are missing/malformed
App boots normally when env vars are correct

depends_on_outputs_from: ProjectArchitectureSetupAgent: /schemas directory exists and TS path aliases configured

tasks.title: Implement Zod schemas
steps: Create /schemas/user.schema.ts with UserRegisterSchema and UserLoginSchema + inferred types
Create /schemas/location.schema.ts with LocationUpdateSchema + inferred type
Create /schemas/voice.schema.ts with VoiceMessageSchema + inferred type
Create /schemas/stress.schema.ts with StressSignalSchema + inferred type
Ensure schemas match spec constraints exactly
verification: Schemas accept valid payloads and reject invalid payloads

tasks.title: Create validation utilities for API and sockets
steps: Create /lib/validate.ts
Implement validateOrThrow(schema, data): uses safeParse, returns typed data or throws a standardized 400 NextResponse with ZodIssue[]
Implement validateSocketEvent(schema, data): uses safeParse and returns a discriminated union Result type
Do not use zod.parse() anywhere
verification: validateOrThrow returns typed output on valid input
validateOrThrow returns 400 error response shape on invalid input
validateSocketEvent returns ok/error union without throwing

must_provide: Schema file list and exported names
Example valid/invalid payloads for each schema
How validateOrThrow and validateSocketEvent are intended to be used

integration_checkpoint.name: Checkpoint A — Foundation Gate
must_pass: EnvSchema fails fast on missing/malformed env vars
All Zod schemas compile and export inferred types
shadcn/ui Button renders without runtime error

stop_condition_to_advance: All integration checkpoint conditions pass with no TypeScript or runtime errors.
